title: round
description: One round of an eval (ADR-0004), optional: what it set out to learn, what changed against the round before, the arms it dropped and why, the baseline it started from, and what it concluded. data/rounds/<goal_id>/<round_id>.yaml, written by evh round-open / round-retire / round-close. Its arms are the configs whose runs name it (`round:` in the config, recorded on the run).

round_id.description: r1, r2, ...: equals the file name.

dataset_id.description: The dataset its arms run on.

hypothesis.description: What the round sets out to learn, in a sentence.

changes.description: What changed against `from`, and why, one line each.

baseline.description: The run it starts from and is measured against: the dataset's promoted baseline when it opened.

carried.description: Config ids from earlier rounds kept in this one unchanged, compared without being run again.

runs_dir.description: The runs directory, relative to data/, whose copy of the config is retired (runs-linux: a re-timing of the same config on another machine). Absent: the project's runs directory.

budget_usd.description: What the round may spend; its billed cost is shown against it.

harness.description: The harness code the round was opened on (round-open): a run of the round recording other code (instrument.harness.code_sha256) is named by evh rounds, with how to run it on this code.

commit.description: The project's commit; in a checkout of the harness, the harness's own.

code_sha256.description: The hash of the harness code that can change a measurement, as runs record it.

installed.description: True when the harness is an installed dependency, not a checkout.

scorer.description: The scorer the round is judged by (RFC-022): 12 characters of its code's sha256, recorded by round-open --scoring.

scoring.description: Each change of the scorer the round is read with (RFC-022): evh rescore --round, or round-open --scoring re-scoring the carried arms.

written.description: The directories the re-scores were written to, relative to data/.
